title: This year's star is next year's average
hook: This year's top fund is usually next year's disappointment. And nobody did anything wrong.
caption: This year's star is next year's average. Of {n} people scored on half skill, half luck, the top tenth fell from the {top_r1} to the {top_r2} percentile; only {still_top} stayed on top.

scenes.say: This year's top fund is usually next year's disappointment. And nobody did anything wrong.
Regression to the mean: when results contain luck, extreme results are usually followed by normal ones.
Code tests {n} people twice. Score is half skill, half luck. The top tenth in round one…
scenes.note: Simulation: score = skill + luck, luck share {luck_share}

scenes.say: Only {still_top} stayed in the top tenth.
They didn't get worse. The luck just didn't repeat. The skill stayed.
Never pick a person, a fund, or a strategy on its best year alone.
scenes.show: Never judge on one great year.

takeaway: Never pick a person, a fund, or a strategy on its best year alone.
